title: Uploading Fake News Dataset to Google Colab

cues.en: Hello guys.
Welcome back to the course.
In this video we are going to learn step by step on how to upload fake datasets to Google Colab.
cues.zh: 這支影片會逐步教你將假新聞資料集上傳到 Google Colab。

cues.en: So make sure that you pay very close attention to this video guys.
So the first thing that you need to do is to create a new file.
So just click file and then click new notebook.
And you're going to be redirected to this page.
And don't forget you need to rename the file first okay.
cues.zh: 別忘了先重新命名檔案。

cues.en: So we're going to name the file as fake news dataset overview.
cues.zh: 我們命名為 Fake News Dataset Overview。

cues.en: Okay.
So you're going to import two libraries.
The first one is pandas because we're going to use pandas to read our dataset.
cues.zh: 第一個是 pandas，因為要用它讀取資料集。

cues.en: So just type in import pandas as PD.
cues.zh: 輸入 import pandas as pd。

cues.en: And the second library that you're going to import is Google Colab okay.
cues.zh: 第二個要匯入的是 google.colab。

cues.en: So just type in from Google Colab.
Import files.
You're going to use this library to upload the data.
cues.zh: 這個模組將用來上傳資料。

cues.en: Okay.
So now let's hit compile.
As you guys can see here, the cell is already running.
So just wait.
Okay.
So we have compiled this code successfully.
cues.zh: 這段程式碼已成功執行。

cues.en: So now what we're going to do next is to create a variable called uploaded.
cues.zh: 接著建立 uploaded 變數。

cues.en: So we're going to have files dot upload and let's hit compile.
Okay.
So now just click choose file.
And let's upload the fake news datasets that we downloaded from Kaggle in the previous video.
cues.zh: 上傳上一支影片從 Kaggle 下載的假新聞資料集。

cues.en: So just click append.
Okay, as you guys can see now it is uploading the dataset.
It seems that the dataset is pretty big.
That's the reason why it might take a while.
cues.zh: 所以可能需要等一會兒。

cues.en: So I don't want this video to be very long, so I'm just going to skip this part.
cues.zh: 為避免影片太長，我先跳過等待的部分。

cues.en: Welcome back guys.
We have successfully uploaded fake news datasets to Google Colab.
cues.zh: 我們已將假新聞資料集成功上傳到 Google Colab。

cues.en: It took a little bit longer than I expected.
It took almost three minutes.
Okay.
So the next thing that we're going to do is to read the data using pandas.
cues.zh: 接著使用 pandas 讀取資料。

cues.en: So just add another block of code.
cues.zh: 新增一個程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: And I'm going to create a variable called data.
And we're going to assign value to this variable.
So it's going to be PD dot read underscore CSV.
And we're going to copy and paste the name of the file.
And then put it inside this parentheses and make sure that it matches exactly the same like this.
cues.zh: 放入括號中，請確保和這裡的檔名完全一致。

cues.en: Otherwise it's not going to work right.
And now let's hit compile guys.
Okay.
So we have successfully read this dataset.
cues.zh: 我們已成功讀取這個資料集。

cues.en: So from now going forward if you want to recall this data, just type in the name of this variable because we assign the dataset as a value to this variable.
cues.zh: 從現在開始，要存取資料時，只要輸入這個變數名稱，因為我們已把資料集指定給它。

cues.en: Make sure you remember that because from now going forward we're going to use this variable a lot.
cues.zh: 請記住，之後會經常使用這個變數。

cues.en: Okay I'll see you guys in the next video.
